I reviewed each provided helper and checked whether it can perform or assist with editing a CMS page title (specifically changing the "About us" page title to "Secret"). - download_revenue_and_orders_report: Not useful — parses revenue and orders from dashboard and returns CSV; not for editing content.
- get_last_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper for extracting last orders CSV; read-only.
- fetch_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — lightweight wrapper around last-orders extraction; not editing.
- export_orders_csv: Not useful — exports Last Orders table with filtering; no page/content editing.
- save_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — saves a CSV to disk from dashboard orders; not relevant to CMS editing.
- export_revenue_and_orders: Not useful — high-level wrapper for revenue/orders export; not CMS editing.
- download_last_orders_summary: Not useful — delegates to export_orders_csv and parses CSV; read-only.
- download_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — convenience wrapper for recent orders CSV; not editing.
- save_last_orders_csv: Not useful — validates dashboard and writes CSV to file; does not edit pages.
- export_last_orders_csv_simple: Not useful — simple wrapper to export Last Orders; not editing.
- export_last_orders_for_store_and_range: Not useful — convenience wrapper for last orders by store/range; not editing.
- export_recent_orders_quick: Not useful — quick wrapper for Last Orders export; read-only.

Conclusion: None of the provided functions are useful for changing the title of a CMS "About us" page to "Secret" because they lack the capability to open the CMS Pages editing UI, modify page content/title, and save changes. To perform the requested task you need a helper that can navigate to the CMS/Pages management area (e.g., /index.php/admin/cms/page/ or similar), locate the "About us" page, open its edit form, modify the title field, and save — none of the listed helpers implement those steps.
